summary: Frontend-only visual verification of AlertDialog CSS exception fix (iteration_13 follow-up). Verified 'Sil' destructive button now shows WHITE text on RED bg across mekanlar/kullanicilar/etkinlikler delete AlertDialogs. However, discovered a NEW REGRESSION affecting standard confirm dialogs: primary action buttons ('Kaydet' in Yeni Mekan, 'Oluştur' in Yeni Etkinlik) render as solid dark blocks with invisible text because the global [role='dialog'] * color override collides with bg-slate-900 primary buttons.

ui_bugs.component: Standard Dialog primary buttons (Yeni Mekan 'Kaydet', Yeni Etkinlik 'Oluştur', likely Yeni Albüm 'Kaydet')
ui_bugs.issue: Primary action buttons render as solid dark blocks with NO visible text. Computed color=rgb(15,23,42) AND backgroundColor=rgb(15,23,42) — text is same color as background. Button uses classes 'bg-slate-900 text-primary-foreground' but the global [role='dialog'] * { color:#0f172a !important } rule in /app/frontend/src/index.css overrides .text-primary-foreground. The recently added exception rules only whitelist .bg-red-600 and .bg-destructive, missing .bg-slate-900/.bg-primary.

verified_working.note: AlertDialog fix from iteration_13 IS working correctly — Sil button is confirmed WHITE (255,255,255) on RED (220,38,38) across all three tested pages. albumler page had no existing albums so delete flow could not be verified but same shared AlertDialog component.

action_items: Extend the CSS exception rules in /app/frontend/src/index.css to cover primary buttons in standard [role='dialog'] modals. Add: [role='dialog'] .bg-slate-900, [role='dialog'] .bg-slate-900 *, [role='dialog'] .bg-primary, [role='dialog'] .bg-primary * { color: #ffffff !important; } — mirror the pattern already used for .bg-red-600/.bg-destructive.
Consider also whitelisting .text-primary-foreground within [role='dialog'] scope (e.g., [role='dialog'] .text-primary-foreground { color: #ffffff !important }) as a more semantically clean solution.
Retest Yeni Mekan / Yeni Etkinlik / Yeni Albüm modals after fix to confirm 'Kaydet' / 'Oluştur' button text is visible white on dark bg.
critical_code_review_comments: The [role='dialog'] * { color: #0f172a !important } sledgehammer rule in index.css is fragile — every new button/text variant needs a manual exception. Consider inverting: scope the light-mode override only to specific text elements (h2, p, label) rather than universal descendants, or use CSS variables for dialog theming.

Note: The AlertDialog description was expected to be 'slate-500 readable' per the review request, but computed color came back as rgb(15,23,42) (slate-900). This is because the description element is not using .text-slate-500 class; the global * override wins. Description IS readable (dark on white) so this is cosmetic, not a bug.

success_rate.frontend: 80% — AlertDialog fix works; standard dialog primary buttons regressed

seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing 'Fotuber Nişanevi Test' venue, 'Fotuber Yönetici' user, and 'Bride Test' event. All AlertDialogs were closed via Vazgeç (no data deleted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: AlertDialog Sil-button-white-on-red fix VERIFIED (rgb 255,255,255 on rgb 220,38,38). But standard [role='dialog'] modals with primary bg-slate-900 buttons now have invisible text — same-color regression from the too-aggressive [role='dialog'] * color override. Main agent should extend the CSS exception to cover .bg-slate-900 / .bg-primary and retest Yeni Mekan/Etkinlik/Albüm create modals.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: CSS specificity conflict. /app/frontend/src/index.css contains: [role='dialog'] *, [role='alertdialog'] * { color: #0f172a !important; } — this forces ALL text inside any dialog to slate-900. The iteration_13 fix added exceptions ONLY for .bg-red-600 and .bg-destructive backgrounds (the destructive Sil button). Primary action buttons (Kaydet/Oluştur) use 'bg-slate-900 text-primary-foreground' — no matching exception exists, so text-primary-foreground (white) is overridden to slate-900, and since bg is also slate-900, the text becomes invisible. Reproduction: /admin/mekanlar → click 'Yeni Mekan' → observe Kaydet button is a dark block with no visible label. Same behavior on /admin/etkinlikler → 'Yeni Etkinlik' → 'Oluştur' button. Mitigation: add [role='dialog'] .bg-slate-900, [role='dialog'] .bg-primary { color: #ffffff !important; } exception rules next to existing .bg-red-600/.bg-destructive rules.
